title: Opioid-Free Total Shoulder With Suzetrigine
official: Opioid-Free Postoperative Analgesia With Suzetrigine Following Total Shoulder Arthroplasty: A Prospective Randomized Controlled Noninferiority Trial
summary: This prospective, randomized, unblinded, controlled noninferiority study may benefit patients by determining whether an opioid-free postoperative analgesic pathway utilizing suzetrigine can provide adequate pain control following primary anatomic or reverse total shoulder arthroplasty compared with a standard opioid-containing pathway. If effective, this strategy may reduce or eliminate routine postoperative opioid use and associated adverse effects while maintaining patient satisfaction and adequate pain control. More broadly, this study will provide prospective data regarding the effectiveness and safety of suzetrigine following total shoulder arthroplasty and may help inform future opioid-free postoperative pain management protocols.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age ≥18 years
2. Undergoing elective primary anatomic or reverse total shoulder arthroplasty
3. English-speaking (for patient-reported outcome assessments)

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Revision arthroplasty procedures
2. Total shoulder arthroplasty performed for a fracture-related indication, including acute fractures and chronic fracture sequelae (e.g., malunion or nonunion)
3. History of chronic opioid use (defined as daily or near-daily use for ≥90 days preoperatively)
4. Contraindications to suzetrigine:

   1. Known allergy or hypersensitivity to suzetrigine
   2. Current use of strong CYP3A inhibitors (contraindicated per FDA labeling)
   3. Current use of strong or moderate CYP3A inducers (should be avoided per FDA labeling)
   4. Severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh Class C)
   5. Severe renal impairment (eGFR \<15 mL/min/1.73 m²)
5. Pregnancy or breastfeeding
6. Inability to complete patient-reported outcome measures
7. Simultaneous bilateral arthroplasty
8. Unable or unwilling to provide informed consent or comply with study procedures
9. Total shoulder arthroplasty performed for an oncologic indication
